## Reproduce or refresh locally

```sh
cd models
python3 -m pip install -r requirements-local.txt
python3 local_cards.py --model gpt-5.6-luna
```

The script downloads from the owner URL, accepts only the publisher's hosts, checks the content type, file signature, SHA-256, title, and model scope terms, then writes the files above. A SHA-256 mismatch means the publisher revised the document; re-verify its scope and update the catalog before trusting the new copy.
